name: Pan-African Biennale x Nairobi Sketch Tour
description: Grab your sketchbook and wander Nairobi's iconic architecture and hidden corners on this creative city walk, teaming up with the Pan-African Biennale. It's part art class, part city adventure — perfect for anyone who wants to see Nairobi through fresh eyes.

name: Mystery & Mayhem: Trivia Night & Live Music
description: Grab a team and test your detective skills at this trivia night packed with global mysteries, clever clues, and live tunes. Good vibes, good company, and bragging rights all in one Friday evening at Kahoffee House.

name: Christie 7s Rugby Sevens Tournament
description: Kenya's most iconic rugby sevens tournament turns 60 this year, and it's less about the scrums and more about the ultimate day-long party atmosphere. Expect fans, families, and rugby royalty coming together for Nairobi's biggest sporting weekend.

name: The Golf Park Ladies Open
venue: Ngong Race Course and Golf Park
description: Ladies, it's tee time — swing pretty, laugh loudly, and blame the wind if the ball misbehaves. Dress in red and white, bring your best golf swagger, and enjoy a playful day on the green.

name: Paint The Run 5
description: Nairobi's most colourful fun run is back with the theme MOTION — think vibrant colour zones, live music, and a whole lot of dancing while you run, walk, or just vibe. It's the ultimate feel-good festival for anyone who wants to move and have fun doing it.

name: Kenya Museum Society Affordable Book Sale and Market
description: Browse secondhand books from KES 100, shop over 30 local vendors, and enjoy free entry at this beloved Nairobi museum market. Bring the whole crew — there are live activities and guided tours too.

name: Zenith All White Day Party
description: Dust off your all-white fit for a rooftop day party overlooking Nairobi National Park, with Nairobi's top turntablists spinning 90s and 2000s anthems. Sip, dance, and soak up the skyline at one of the city's most scenic sundowner spots.

name: Sondeka ALT – 5th Edition
description: Nairobi's biggest celebration of Kenyan creativity returns with a full day of music, performance, literature, and art under the theme 'The Comeback'. Best part? It's completely free entry, so bring your retro fit and come vibe.

name: Mapenzi Vibandaski – 4th Edition • Day Ones
description: This intimate storytelling and soul-music series returns with performances from Hildah Watiri, Mutoriah, Ywaya Tajiri and more. Come celebrate the friendships that started it all over good food and even better music.

name: The Lore's POP Up
description: Early tickets already sold out for this listening party celebrating the year's biggest pop albums, followed by a DJ set spinning all your favourite hits. Expect big singalong energy at 254 Beer District.

name: Roots n Riddim
description: Nairobi R&B is going big for this one, bringing UK jazz powerhouse Yussef Dayes and his band for a meticulously curated live experience. Grab GA, VIP or VVIP tickets and get ready for a night of real musicianship.

name: Night of the Moonflower
description: An all-female cast brings poetry, live music, and storytelling together in this immersive arts experience inspired by the flower that blooms in the dark. It's soulful, reflective, and unlike anything else on Nairobi's calendar this week.

name: Sudhee Experience
description: Comedian Jaymo Decin brings 'laughter beyond the screen' with one man playing many personalities for a night of nonstop stand-up. Mark the date at KICC for endless laughs.

name: The Nitalewa Experience
description: An intimate live acoustic session for people who genuinely appreciate real music — think stripped-back sets and good conversation over drinks. A chill way to spend your Saturday afternoon at Suave Kitchen and Social Club.

name: Viva México! An Independence Day Brunch
description: The Embassy of Mexico and The Social House team up for a Sunday brunch bursting with bold Mexican flavours, cocktails, and live music, courtesy of Chefs Panda, José and Aníbal. Come hungry and ready to say Viva México!
